summary: Built the deterministic 1v1 duel as pure integer code. packages/content/src/moves holds the input bits, zod schemas and validators (the move timing reuses moveTimingSchema), the Duelist moveset (jab, heavy mid, low sweep and throw take their timing objects from baselineFrameBudgets; launcher, anti-air, advancing thrust and counter slash are the worker's choice), the §7 rules, the arena, MOVESET_VERSION 'duelist-1' and the input-log schema. packages/simulation/src/duel holds the state, stepDuel (inputs, then detection against the start-of-frame state, then same-frame interactions, then simultaneous apply, then movement, then stamina and result), boxes, snapshotDuel/restoreDuel, replayDuel/traceDuel/sliceDuelInputLog and createDuelInputLog. Subpath exports @pirate-sea-race/simulation/duel and @pirate-sea-race/content/moves follow the existing pattern, and each package has a postbuild that imports its subpath from dist/ without the source condition (it exits 1 when the source condition sends it to src/). docs/duel.md is written. Tests: 47 rule tests (round, timeout, overtime, double KO, a KO on the final frame, simultaneous hits, movement, walls, pushboxes, guard levels, throws with escape window, clash and strike priority, stamina costs, regeneration and guard break, combo scaling and cap, the 4-frame buffer, heavy mid -12 punished by a jab in the corner at max range and midscreen), 10 determinism, rollback, version and symmetry tests (frame-by-frame mirror with slots swapped; a one-sub-pixel wall asymmetry was confirmed to fail it), and 40 content validator tests. Checks run in this worktree after npm ci: npm run typecheck (exit 0), npm run test:unit (183 passed), npm run test:integration (14 passed), npm run build (exit 0; both postbuild self-checks and the build smoke test passed). No commits were made; only owned paths changed.
open_assumptions: Counter slash is a reversal: strikes pass through its whole 8-frame startup; no parry/counter stance (that overlaps deferred Observation Haki).
Up + down held together is also neutral, like left + right (§8 names only horizontal).

Guard break replaces the blockstun with 30 frames of stagger from the breaking frame and sets stamina to 30; after a broken heavy mid the attacker is only +2, while a broken jab is punishable (tested).
'An active strike beats a throw' is read literally: a fighter whose strike hitbox is active that frame cannot be grabbed, even if the strike whiffs.
Throw escape counts only presses after the grab (the buffer is cleared at the grab): the window is grab+1..grab+10, and the throw lands on grab+11; a throw causes a 30-frame non-hittable knockdown.
Frame convention: startup = frames before the first active frame; blockstun and hitstun include the contact frame, so advantage = blockstun - active - recovery.
Jab hitstun 24 (+9 on hit) so that jabs link and the five-hit cap is reachable; balance (15-25% combos) is untuned.
Pushback is applied instantly; fighters can jump over each other (80 px pushbox); there is no air guard and there are no air attacks.
DuelState.rng is seeded and carried but no rule draws from it yet.
scripts/smoke-build.ts and packages/test-tools are unchanged, as decided; the new subpaths are proven by the postbuild scripts only.
untested: Combo damage targets (15-25% of health) and overall balance of the chosen frame data.
Launcher juggles beyond the first launch, and airborne hitstun landing behaviour.
Tie-breaks when both fighters share the same x (the facing-based pushbox and pushback direction).
Step performance (the §19 p95 < 8 ms target) was not measured.
restoreDuel only checks the moveset version and the basic shape (frame, two fighters, safe integers), not every fighter field of an untrusted snapshot.
verify_yourself: That modelling the counter slash as a strike-invulnerable reversal (not a parry stance), and the guard-break stagger replacing blockstun (so a broken heavy is only +2), match the intended reading of §7/§9.
